# Fallout 76 Patch Notes – April 22, 2025

April 22, 2025

Welcome to spring with a new seasonal event and the start of the first-ever Outlaws of Appalachia mini-season. Today's update marks the debut of mini-seasons and we welcome spring with a brand-new seasonal event. Read on to learn the full patch notes. Update version 1.7.19.19 and download sizes Find out the download size of today's update on each platform:

**PC (Steam)**: 3.6 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 15.7 GB
**Xbox**: 20.3GB
**PlayStation**: 15.4GB

## A breath of fresh air for challenge events

Challenge events like Science of Love and Pioneers of the Wild were a great way to bring the community together and provide some fun rewards. However, we felt that these events in their current form were easily missed by players, leaving many people missing out on unique rewards. We also had the impression that the system for unlocking rewards when starting a new event was always causing confusion. For this reason, we are revamping the challenge events a bit so that it is now easier for you to find out when an event is taking place and it is less complicated to receive the rewards. From now on, challenge events are called **Mini Seasons**, and you can find the latest one right next to the current season in the Season menu. To claim rewards in a Mini Season, you need Season Tickets. Completing all event challenges will earn you enough tickets to unlock all rewards, but if you have enough tickets at the start of a mini-season, you can also unlock all rewards immediately. If you want to unlock all the rewards of the main season, all you have to do is complete the current mini-season challenges to get your tickets back. Aside from these new features, the mini-season isn't much different from the challenge events as you know them. You start with a free reward (which you can get now in the mini-season and more in the Atomic Shop) and a challenge in which you have to wear this reward. You will then need to complete the mini-season challenges to earn more season tickets and unlock the remaining rewards. The first mini-season begins today with “**Outlaws of Appalachia**”. Take a look at this article to see what rewards await you.
## The big blooming – from April 29th

### Spring is here!

Say hello to Violet Susan. She loves flowers and arrangements and has a penchant for violence. Right now she needs your help with her latest project. Violet Susan's favorite meadow has been taken over by strange plant-like creatures called Overgrowns. Because of her, it is too dangerous for Susan to pick flowers in this area. And for this reason you now have to go to the meadow for them, pick a few flowers and kill these monsters. After you have collected flowers and attacked the overgrown creatures explosively, Susan's arch enemy Biezelbub, the king of all bees, appears. Defeat him and claim your rewards! But be careful of the mines. They are the remnants of Susan's previous attempts to keep these annoying beasts away from the meadow.
## Armor

- Power Armor no longer removes the Ghoul Camouflage headgear.
- Vulcan Ultracite Bracers' radiation and poison effects are now correctly identified as "unarmed" effects.
